name: Natsumoto Fuuka
source:
Hobbies: Listening to music, shoujo manga.
Special Skill: Interacting with animals
Favourite foods: Omurice and hamburger.
Hated foods: Spicy dishes.

Ritsu's younger sister, she started to attend Wizure at a young age.
Fuuka is unfriendly and very reserved, she always tries to act grown-up and gets mad when treated like a child.
Has a complex because of her big breasts and wishes they could become small with magic.
